purpose: Fail closed after a documentation-page schema inspection unexpectedly rendered public external CYP3A4 record previews before the required EXP-X1 provenance and acquisition contract existed.

incident.operation_intent: Read public source documentation for endpoint, unit, assay, row-count, and license metadata only.
incident.unexpected_behavior: Opening the dataset-card documentation around its schema also rendered exact public compound records and CYP3A4 values in the tool response.
incident.count_policy: Forty-five record rows were present in the returned excerpts. The source page may have rendered more internally; exact reconstruction is unnecessary because any positive count rejects the zero-record precondition.
incident.scientific_use: No exposed identity, structure, target value, ordering, distribution, or row relationship may enter source selection, filtering, thresholding, modeling, validation, or submission work.

boundary_decision.decision: Reject this pre-contract source-audit path. It cannot become the EXP-X1 provenance contract or evidence for acquisition feasibility.
boundary_decision.scientific_scope: This is a capability-governance rejection only. It contains no model-quality, overlap, support, assay-transfer, or leaderboard inference.
boundary_decision.no_retry_semantics: Do not repeat or repair the rejected dataset-card browsing path. A separate metadata-only contract freeze may proceed because no experiment contract, execution claim, external file, official input, fit, prediction, or metric existed.

containment.rule: Do not reopen the dataset card, Data Studio, file preview, raw data URL, or resolve URL before an integrated child contract grants acquisition. Use repository metadata APIs and protocol/license prose only for the replacement freeze.

next_gate: After reviewed signed integration and green post-main CI, freeze a separate metadata-only G2-5A EXP-X1 provenance and acquisition-feasibility contract. Bind this rejection, allowlist only exact repository-metadata and protocol/license resources, select at most one source, acquire zero additional external records, open zero official input, and grant no acquisition until that new contract is itself reviewed, integrated, and green.
